title: Big-name recruiter wants documents now
scenario: A recruiter claiming to represent a well-known company offers you a remote interview. Before scheduling it, they ask for a driver’s licence, tax number and bank details “to pre-clear onboarding.”

answers.A: Verify the recruiter and role through the company’s official careers site or HR contact before sharing sensitive information.
answers.B: Ask to interview first and provide only the information normally needed at that stage.
answers.C: Send the ID but hold back bank details until after the interview.

explanation: Real employers may need identity and payroll data after hiring, not before they have established a genuine process.
proTip: Hiring should get more specific before your data gets more sensitive.
